history.period: Modern temple; founding date not published
history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: of the many Vitthal-Rukmini mandirs in Sangli district, the most documented Sangli-city referent is the Shri Vitthal Rukmini Mandir at Ahilyadevi Housing Society, Abhay Nagar, Sangli 416416, a Vaishnavite neighbourhood temple dedicated to Vitthal and his consort Rukmini in the Varkari tradition. Directory listings give its working hours as 8:00 AM-8:00 PM daily and a contact phone (+91 94211 81484). No official history or founding date is published, so antiquity cannot be verified — the temple appears to be modern. It must not be confused with the famous Shri Vitthal-Rukmini Mandir (Vithoba Temple) at Pandharpur, Solapur district, the main Varkari centre built in the Hoysala period (1108-1152 CE). If the CSV row intended the Pandharpur temple or another Sangli-district shrine, re-map accordingly.

name: Vitthal Rukmini Temple, Sangli (Abhay Nagar)
town_description: Abhay Nagar is a residential neighbourhood in Sangli city, western Maharashtra; the mandir sits in the Ahilyadevi Housing Society, close to Sangli railway station.

travel.road: Sangli city is on NH-48 and well connected by road

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Ashadhi and Kartiki Ekadashi are the main Varkari festival periods
visitor_information.opening_hours: 8:00 AM-8:00 PM daily (per directory listing; verify locally)
